course_name_original: Sistemas Electrónicos de Medida y Transmisión de Señales
course_name_en: Electronic Measurement and Signal Transmission Systems
prerequisites: Fundamentals of sensors and signal conditioners

learning_outcomes.text: Upon passing the course, the student will be able to select the appropriate sensor for common electrical measurements: voltage, current, resistance, capacitance, charge, etc.
Upon passing the course, the student will be able to design a complete basic measurement system for the most common electrical measurements.
Upon passing the course, the student will be able to select and use appropriate laboratory instrumentation for measuring electrical signals.
Upon passing the course, the student will be able to select the transmission medium according to the characteristics of the signal to be transmitted and the specifications.
Upon passing the course, the student will be able to select and use suitable commercial circuits for magnitude conversion and signal modulation and demodulation.

assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, a minimum score of 5 out of 10 in the Theoretical Exam (T1) is mandatory. The final grade is calculated as (0.95 x (0.5 x (P1 + T1))) + (0.05 x PA), provided all minimums are met. Otherwise, the final grade will be the minimum of the calculated score and 4.0. For the extraordinary call, the theoretical exam evaluates all theoretical content, and the grade obtained in this exam will be the final grade for this part. In case of doubt regarding authorship or unauthorized means, a face-to-face defense may be requested.
